title: The Sun Kiss | Designer 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: The Sun Kiss is a family-friendly 30A home near Eastern Lake with a private pool, bikes, a golf cart, and easy beach access close to dining and shops.
description_expanded: The Sun Kiss Features - Southside 30A - 350 yards to the Eastern Lake Beach Access. The coastal dune lake flows into the Gulf at this beach entrance, a rare ecological phenomenon only found in 4 countries including the USA. You can visit 15 of these artisan spring fed lakes on 30A. - 4 Min LSV (golf cart) ride to Walton Dunes Beach Access. Beach service available at this entrance. - Access to a 6-Seater LSV (golf cart). Restrictions apply and must sign a waiver for access to the cart - Private Pool - can be heated for an additional fee October through April - 4 Backpack beach chairs, 2 beach umbrellas, and a beach cart available for bringing your items to the beach - Fenced-in, landscaped back yard with charcoal grill, sundeck, lounge seating, and covered porch with cushioned seating - Access to 4 bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape for your stay - Views of Eastern Lake from front balcony - 2-minute bike ride to Old Florida Beach House, Beachy Bean Coffee Company, and Buddy's Seafood Market - 1 minute bike or LSV (golf cart) drive to Greenway Station with lots of shopping and dining, including Turbo Coffee, Local Cantina, and Free People - Parking for 4 vehicles in driveway - room for 2 large SUVS plus 2 additional cars. RV, street, or trailer parking not available - King Suite on 1st floor - perfect for grandparents! - Gorgeous kitchen with stainless-steel appliances including 6 burner gas range, stand-alone ice maker, dishwasher, and microwave - Keurig and Drip Coffee Makers - Dining area with seating for 6 plus nearby breakfast bar seating for 5 - Open main living room with large SmartTV and views of the pool area - 2nd Floor Laundry room - Sitting area on 2nd floor landing - WIFI and cable throughout home - USB Charging stations in bedrooms - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Gorgeous, family friendly home next to Eastern Lake and only 350 yards to the beach! This will be your families new go to spot for enjoying 30A. Perfectly located close to the beach, dining, shopping, and Eastern Lake with the added benefit of being in a quieter neighborhood. What makes The Sun Kiss so special? All suite and spacious bedrooms (including a large king suite on the 1st floor), large private pool with a fenced in backyard, lake view from the balcony, designer interiors, gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances including a Samsung Smart Fridge with Spotify and a built-in speaker, and 4 bikes plus an LSV (golf cart) for exploring the area. Your family will thank you for picking such a wonderful and warm vacation spot.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, dresser and walk-in closet for storage, ceiling fan, ensuite bath with dual vanity sinks, claw foot tub, and walk-in shower

2nd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, dresser plus reach-in and walk-in closets for storage, ceiling fan, private balcony with rocking chairs and views of Eastern Lake, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower
2nd Floor Queen Suite | TV, dresser and walk-in closet for storage, private balcony with seating and view of back yard, ensuite bath with claw foot tub and large walk-in shower

2nd Floor Bunk Suite | Sleeping for 4 in a Twin over Queen Bunk with Twin trundle, lots of floor space, ladder and guard rail for top bunk, TV, dresser and walk-in closet for storage, ensuite bath with vanity sink and walk-in shower

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
